name: DishChannelArea
comment: Returns the cross-section area of a parabolic dish channel. Argument order is Width, then Height. The dish is the parabola through (0, 0), (Width/2, -Height), and (Width, 0). Width is the top chord and Height is the depth below that chord. For positive Width and Height the area is (2/3)*Width*Height. Width 0 returns #DIV/0!. Non-numeric input returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
